label: preparing
what: A surprise jubilee celebration for the mayor's forty years of service, in the great hall tomorrow at 18:00. Freight reports needing 200 fresh loaves and having eight lanterns; the builder's lighting inspection and escort appear to provide the occasion for bringing the mayor in. Secretary knowingly reserves the time and relays coordination. Freight is seeking the innkeeper's help, but the innkeeper's participation and the baker's knowledge are not yet confirmed.
